messages:
Lina: hey team — first day. my okta flow is stuck on device trust and wants a passkey. I don’t have my phone with me to scan the QR and 1Password invite hasn’t arrived (lina.w@redwood.com) :wave:
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Lina! Provisioning kicked off. Snapshot: Okta user created, Jamf onboarding pending, 1Password seat pending, Google Drive share pending.
Marco (IT): hi @Lina. two quick q's: do you see a prompt to register a passkey or to enroll a security key? also which browser/os are you on?
Lina: Macbook Pro, macOS 13, Firefox. it shows "Enroll device trust" with a QR. when I try to "use a security key" it errors "passkey not supported"
Marco (IT): thanks. sounds like the browser/passkey mismatch. temporary option: I can enable TOTP for 24h while we get Jamf & passkey sorted. prefer TOTP or SMS?
Sam (People Ops): fyi SMS fallback is restricted, but security can approve short windows. Lina — do you have a yubikey or an android phone you can use for passkey?
Lina: I have an old U2F yubikey and an Android phone. phone is corporate locked rn so can't install the authenticator app. U2F older standard might not work with the new passkey flow.
Security Bot: automated note: SMS fallback requires approval. Security has provisionally approved a 24h TOTP window for lina.w@redwood.com — Marco to enable.
Marco (IT): turned on temporary TOTP for user and sent 1Password invite manually (INVITE ID: 9a7c-df). Also triggered Jamf enrollment email. command: `/admin/tools/enable-totp --user=lina.w@redwood.com --ttl=24h`
Marco (IT): resending Jamf enrollment now — if it doesn't land check spam or the "Company Devices" mailbox.
Lina: got the 1Password invite, setting up vaults now. thanks! still no Jamf email yet.
Priya: welcome Lina :tada: Ill add you to the eng channels once groups sync. ping me when Drive is visible.
Marco (IT): added you to eng-team group and to shared drive "eng/sprint-2026" ACL explicitly as a fallback. you should see Drive link in a minute.
Lina: yep I can see the shared drive now. device trust still shows pending but I can access git and jira via SSO with TOTP.
Sam (People Ops): glad that worked. well ship your hardware yubikey from office stock for long-term passkey use — expect tracking later today.
Lina: perfect, thanks everyone. appreciate the quick help. :relieved:
Onboarding Bot: Provisioning update: Okta SSO accessible (with temporary TOTP), 1Password seat active, Drive access granted, Jamf enroll pending. Ticket will auto-close in 2h if no further updates.
Priya: welcome aboard again — shout if you want a quick repo tour later.
